title: The Unsolved Indiana Dunes Disappearances
summary: Hosts Josh Clark and Chuck Bryant examine the unsolved July 2, 1966 disappearance of three young women from Indiana Dunes State Park on Lake Michigan: Patricia Blow, Ann Miller, and Renee Brule. The episode covers the beach day, the women wading out around noon, witness reports of a white Tryhold runabout with turquoise interior and a cabin cruiser, the search, the investigation's leads (Renee's letter, Ann's pregnancy, Silas Jane's criminal links), Harold Blow's lifelong vigil, a psychic's cabin description, and theories including drowning, Wiley's botched-abortion theory, the Largo connection, Silas Jane involvement, faked disappearance, and Richard Speck. A listener mail segment closes the episode.

segments.title: Opening banter and tour dates
segments.summary: Josh and Chuck open with tour dates in Portland and Vancouver, then a long tangent about spin-off TV shows (Too Close for Comfort, Laverne and Shirley, Cleveland Show) before previewing the mystery.

segments.title: The three women and the beach day
segments.summary: Patricia Blow, Ann Miller and Renee Brule set out July 2, 1966 for Indiana Dunes State Park over the July 4 weekend. The beach was crowded. They waded into the water around noon and were last seen then; a teenage couple nearby left their belongings with a ranger.

segments.title: Car found and the missing persons case opens
segments.summary: Harold Blow called the park about his daughter. Rangers found a Buick matching a key ring in the lot, and Indiana State Police took over the case. The women left purses, money, a transistor radio and suntan lotion behind, which seemed suspicious.

segments.title: Large search and early investigation
segments.summary: A large land, sea and air search with soldiers, Civil Air Patrol, Coast Guard, dive teams and a dune buggy found nothing. Critics note the search began two days late. Renee's letter about her marriage was found in her purse; her husband was cleared.

segments.title: Ann's pregnancy and the horse stable connection
segments.summary: Ann Miller was reportedly about three months pregnant, possibly by a married man. Patricia also reportedly dated a married man. Both worked around a horse stable run by a brother of Silas Jane, a violent criminal police linked to many crimes.

segments.title: Witness sightings: Tryhold runabout and cabin cruiser
segments.summary: A teenage couple from Indianapolis said the women got on a white Tryhold runabout with turquoise interior driven by a tanned man with dark wavy hair. Other reports said the women later returned to the beach and got on a larger cabin cruiser with no visible name; a sanded-off name and red paint were found.

segments.title: Boat wreckage, home movies and the vanishing
segments.summary: Boat debris washed ashore but was not linked to the boats sought, and no boat was reported wrecked that weekend. Home movies from the beach seemed to show the women on a runabout. Nothing came of the boat appeals.

segments.title: Harold Blow's vigil and the psychic clue
segments.summary: Harold Blow kept searching for years, chartered planes for reconnaissance and stayed in touch with police and reporters. A psychic described a lakeside cabin with a rotted lawn chair; police found a matching cabin nine years later, but digging found no body.

segments.title: Theories: drowning, Wiley, Largo, Silas Jane, faked disappearance, Speck
segments.summary: Theories include drowning (the women were strong swimmers, Lake Michigan is deadly), Dick Wiley's botched-abortion-on-a-houseboat theory tied to the Largo clinic and their nephew Ralph, a Silas Jane car-bombing witness theory with an unverified insurance claim, a faked disappearance theory from Patricia's brother, and a Richard Speck theory which the hosts find unlikely.

segments.title: Listener mail from Catherine in Chicago
segments.summary: A listener who recently divorced says the show's old episodes keep her company during kid-free time and thanks the hosts and team.

segments.title: Sign-off
segments.summary: Hosts invite listeners to get in touch through the website, social links and email.
